# Design point P020

## Description

The system validates replica freshness with conditional object-store metadata checks before serving repository reads, helping ensure clients access current durable copies. On the client, a Git-aware filesystem watcher monitors relevant working-tree changes while respecting repository exclusions, reducing unnecessary event processing; the two mechanisms address different layers and are compatible.
